name: Helm of Kaldra
text: Equipped creature has first strike, trample, and haste.\n{1}: If you control Equipment named Helm of Kaldra, Sword of Kaldra, and Shield of Kaldra, create Kaldra, a legendary 4/4 colorless Avatar creature token. Attach those Equipment to it.\nEquip {2}
